title: Medication Authorization Permission Slip Form
subtitle: An original operational permission slip for medication authorization that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Medication Authorization Permission Slip Form supports the complete medication authorization workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Medication Authorization Permission Slip Form when the assigned medication record coordinator needs one fillable record for supplied medication directions, custody, administration authority, exceptions, and handoff without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Medication authorization permission slip identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this permission slip to one supplied medication directions, custody, administration authority, exceptions, and handoff record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Medication authorization record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Medication authorization scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Medication authorization requested participation and permission scope
sections.guidance: Separate each requested activity and condition so one choice does not imply another.

blocks.label: Medication authorization permission choices
items: Receipt and storage under the named program and current policy
Administration only from the linked qualified directions
Named timing or condition exactly as documented
Student self-carry or self-administration only from an approved source
Minimum-necessary communication with authorized staff
Emergency response and guardian contact through documented routes
Return, disposal, or transfer only through approved custody
Declined, held, or stopped administration recorded without guessing
blocks.guidance: Each item is independent; document any exclusion or condition in the scope table.

blocks.label: Permission and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records medication authorization and custody; it does not prescribe, interpret, change, or guess a medication, dose, route, timing, diagnosis, or response. Use only current guardian authorization and qualified directions under applicable policy. Stop administration on any mismatch or uncertainty, use emergency services when indicated, protect privacy, and route decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Medication authorization guardian routing, readiness, and support review
sections.guidance: Confirm contact, release, support, and stop conditions before relying on the permission record.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring review before participation
items: Student, medication, label, or authorization record does not match
Qualified direction is missing, illegible, expired, or changed
Required dose, route, timing, or condition cannot be confirmed from the approved source
Medication is unavailable, damaged, contaminated, or outside storage requirements
Authorized staff or required administration setting is unavailable
Student refuses, misses, vomits, or has an unexpected response
Immediate illness, reaction, overdose concern, or emergency response is active
Administration, inventory, custody, or guardian handoff does not reconcile

blocks.label: Participation support, limitation, owner, and evidence
Guardian questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

fields.label: Questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

sections.title: Medication authorization permission decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Preserve approved, declined, conditional, and unresolved scope as separate decisions.

blocks.label: Medication authorization permission decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the guardian, qualified health professional, and authorized medication administrator.

blocks.label: Decision rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

fields.label: Rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

sections.title: Medication authorization permission exceptions and operating handoff
sections.guidance: Do not force agreement; assign unresolved scope and communicate operating limits.

blocks.label: Permission exception and stop indicators
items: Medication administration cannot proceed from the current record
Guardian authorization or qualified direction is incomplete
Student, medication, label, dose, route, timing, or condition does not reconcile
Authorized staff, storage, supply, or required setting is unavailable
Immediate reaction, overdose concern, illness, or emergency response is active
Administration, inventory, custody, or guardian handoff remains unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, immediate control, owner, escalation, and disposition
Approved-scope handoff requirements
items: Approved and declined scope communicated to assigned staff
Conditions and stop points visible at the point of use
Guardian and qualified-review sources linked
Release, transport, or setting limits routed when applicable
Unresolved permission has an owner and due point
Completion evidence and record location identified

sections.title: Medication authorization outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Medication authorization closeout controls
items: Medication status and administration record accepted
Guardian and qualified-review communication recorded
Unresolved variance or follow-up has an owner
Medication and related equipment returned to approved custody
Emergency, health, pharmacy, or program follow-up linked
Medication record stored with privacy and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Permission Slip closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
